admission.justification: The due claim spans the writer, the serving projection and the extracted bridge reader, and prevents the costly error of leaving a held seat until a deadline the host has already passed, or reading the same due report twice in one tick.

applicability: Every held-delivery tick while the limit file holds a live report whose next check is due.
conditions: A report is due when the later of its observedAt and its lastReadAttemptAt is at least five minutes old.
The tick claims the attempt under the same file lock that writes the replacement, before the host call.
A due report is read through one eligible mapped seat that is still in the role record.
A stamped-end read keeps its own observedAt and does not postpone a due periodic read.
exclusions: A report whose reset has passed and that no role mapping names.
A tick with no stamped end and no due report: that tick performs no usage read.
statement: The held-delivery tick rechecks each active limit after five minutes through one mapped seat, with a persisted attempt time and a forced refresh for any role.
